content.rendered:
?

Isaiah 43:2b MSG
…When you’re between a rock and a hard place, it won’t be a dead end –
?
One could liken this kind of situation to that time the Israelites were caught up between the red sea and Pharaoh’s chariots and horsemen. That wasn’t a joyous moment at all having experienced first hand what those horsemen were capable of.
?
It was really a situation between a rock and a hard place.
?God is reassuring you again that no matter what the enemy throws at you, no matter what circumstances bring your way, it will not be a dead end for you

God will always create a way out for you.
This year?
?You will not be stranded.
?Your head will not be bowed down.
?You will not walk through this year all by yourself.
?
It is a year you will experience an avalanche of breakthroughs in every situation including difficult situations.

You will keep SOARING even above the “clouds” in Jesus name
